question:
Read the below statements marked as Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Mark the correct option:

Assertion (A):

Mission Amrit Sarovar focuses on strengthening water conservation efforts in India.

Reason (R):

The mission targets the development of 75 water bodies in every district.

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mission Amrit Sarovar** is a flagship initiative launched by the **Government of India in April 2022**.
 
• The mission aims to **strengthen water conservation efforts** by developing and rejuvenating water bodies across the country.
 
• The specific target of the mission is to **develop at least 75 Amrit Sarovars (water bodies) in each district** of India as part of the celebration of **Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav**.
 
• The initiative focuses on **sustainability, community participation**, and ensuring water availability for **agricultural and ecological purposes**.
 
• It involves multiple stakeholders, including **district administrations, Panchayati Raj institutions, and local communities**.
 
• The mission not only focuses on water conservation but also aims to address **environmental and socio-economic challenges**.
 
• The assertion (A), which states that the mission focuses on water conservation efforts, is accurate as the mission's primary goal is the preservation and sustainable use of water resources.
 
• The reason (R), which explains the specific target of the mission (75 water bodies per district), is also correct and directly supports the assertion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Water Conservation in India**__

 __
 
• Water conservation has become a critical issue in India due to **increasing demand, declining water quality, and limited availability**.
 
• Several government initiatives like **Jal Shakti Abhiyan, National Water Mission**, and now Mission Amrit Sarovar aim to address water-related challenges.
 
• Such missions emphasize the **rejuvenation of traditional water bodies**, rainwater harvesting, and sustainable water management practices.
 
 
 
• **Community Participation in Conservation**__
 
 
• **Community engagement** is essential in ensuring the long-term success of water conservation projects.
 
• Programs like Mission Amrit Sarovar encourage **local bodies, NGOs, and citizens** to take ownership of water resources.
 
• This approach helps in achieving sustainable development goals and mitigating the effects of **droughts and climate change**.
